what: At Sri's request ("Drop the time limits for now. Let's just measure how long things take and why"), raised athena.toml time limits: reader, planner, critic, producer and verifier to 86400 s; check_timeout_s to 14400 s as a hung-test guard.
why: Six jobs since 13 Nov evening failed when the planner, escalated to xhigh on revision rounds, hit the 600 s planner limit; Sri chose to remove the limits and measure instead.
